The platform sizes follow [GitHub’s guidance](https://docs.github.com/en/enterprise-cloud%40latest/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) and [X’s guidance](https://help.x.com/en/managing-your-account/common-issues-when-uploading-profile-photo).
I should export github one in which format ?

Export the **GitHub 500 × 500 frame as a PNG at 1×**. Keep the Chalk background and check that the file is under **1 MB** before uploading. GitHub recommends about 500 × 500 pixels and accepts PNG for profile pictures.
